contract: PRESENTATION_V5.md section 19 (presentation 6, Desk Dial r3 release 1)
about: Desk Dial r3 release 1 appends to the presentation-5 contract: the layouts lights / lightsbig / scenes, the ring styles bri / ctemp (ring.kelvin int 2200..6500, required there) and clusters (1 <= count <= 20, index < count), ring.kelvin validated on every style and kept only on bri / ctemp, valueUnit ("%" | "K", kept on lightsbig), prevTitle / nextTitle (text <= 64 B, kept on scenes) and the icons bulb thermo power wand house album. [r3.1] appends the crumb `playlists`, the ring style `queue` (count >= 1, index < count; `now` kept on it) and `holdMarker` (bool).
